requested_outcome: Replace the heavy first-view place map with a persisted static map image and open the existing interactive map only after activation, while a weekly guarded job fills missing or changed snapshots for every eligible public place.
natural_destination: VII public place detail location sections across vacation, events, spa, hourly and other mapped discovery worlds.
authorization_boundary: Implement and verify the bug-batch candidate only. Do not publish, buy a map plan, create vendor credentials or mutate production until Adir closes the batch and authorizes publication.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request combines visible behavior, persisted state and an unattended weekly recovery path.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require end-to-end success, missing-image, provider-failure, reload and affected-family evidence before completion.

lesson_bundle.reason: The map preview must be clean, immediately understandable and responsive rather than another framed banner.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inspect desktop and 390px preview geometry, overlay placement, attribution and the transition to the live map.

lesson_bundle.reason: A map snapshot is public media and must truthfully represent the same approved location with preserved attribution.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Reject unrelated fallback imagery, broken images, hidden attribution or snapshots whose coordinates do not match the place record.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The first view still loads Leaflet or remote tiles and the page does not feel instant.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Render only the stored image before activation and keep Leaflet behind the existing explicit map-open action.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Before activation there is an image request but no Leaflet canvas or OSM tile request; after activation the interactive map appears.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the pictured vacation place works while spa, hourly or event pages keep the old behavior.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Implement the behavior in the shared map component and inventory every caller and map tone.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Shared-component tests cover all map tones and representative detail routes.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A transient provider failure deletes a good map image or leaves a broken blank block.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Upload and validate a new immutable object before swapping metadata; retain the last ready object on failure and use the verified place image only when no snapshot exists yet.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Failure-path test proves the prior ready object remains active and the UI has no broken image.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The weekly process is only a chat reminder or a cron claim that cannot run in the deployed environment.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add an idempotent reconciler to the existing Worker schedule path and record status in the database, while explicitly retaining the known production scheduler truth boundary.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A deterministic schedule test selects the weekly window once, skips duplicate runs and records missing, ready and failed states.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The implementation scrapes community OSM tiles in violation of the provider policy or removes map attribution.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use a configured static-images provider, never headless tile scraping, and preserve visible provider/OSM attribution.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Source test rejects the public OSM tile host as a snapshot provider and verifies visible attribution metadata.

affected_family: shared ListingMap preview and activation states
Hebrew, English, Russian and French labels

sources.label: User-provided desired static-map preview and current interactive-map screenshots

midpoint_gate.trigger: One exact-coordinate place has a persisted snapshot, instant preview and click-to-live-map transition with failure preservation tests.
checks: Snapshot metadata and immutable object agree
No live map dependency loads before activation
Desktop and mobile preview retain correct aspect and overlay geometry
A failed refresh preserves the last ready image

attack_questions: Can a missing provider key, timeout, 429 or invalid body replace a good snapshot or expose a broken image?
Can duplicate weekly invocations regenerate the same place or overlap through an expired lease?
Does any mapped detail caller still show a business photo while claiming it is a map snapshot?
Is attribution visible on the static preview and the interactive map in desktop and mobile layouts?
Does activating, closing, reloading or using keyboard focus leave the page or map in a stuck state?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Frozen public temporary candidate screenshots and network/interaction checks are required before release; code and local tests alone remain candidate evidence.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated family inventory plus representative vacation, event, spa, hourly and attraction detail checks on desktop and 390px mobile.

effectiveness.baseline: Current shared preview uses the place photograph and initializes Leaflet only after activation, but there is no persisted map snapshot metadata or weekly generator.
effectiveness.target: Every eligible caller uses one shared static-map path, a provider outage preserves prior media, and the first view makes zero interactive tile requests.
